items.title: Confirm it's you
items.body: Changing your password or email, or deleting your account, now first asks you to confirm it's you: with a passkey, Apple, your password or a code we email you. One check is good for 5 minutes.

items.title: 2-step sign-in
items.body: Account → Security: turn on a 6-digit code from your authenticator app after your password, with recovery codes in case you lose your phone. Sign in with Apple and passkeys skip it.

items.title: Passkeys
items.body: Add a passkey in Account → Security, then sign in with Face ID, no email or password to type.
